deviations.claim_in_article: “Meta executives admitted” that starting the test without proper disclosure was a mistake.
deviations.issue: The Ledger attributes this acknowledgment to one Meta Superintelligence Labs vice president, whereas the article broadly attributes it to “Meta executives.” The Japanese source already uses the broader term “Metaの幹部.”
deviations.explanation: The attribution is less precise and pluralized relative to the Ledger, but the underlying acknowledgment and Meta attribution are preserved; this imprecision is already present in the Japanese source.

prior_issues_resolved.explanation: The article says the human concierge feature was rolled back and explicitly says Muse as a whole was not stopped. It no longer presents the rollback as a pause of the phone AI feature overall.
